sentinel1.caption: Sentinel-1 SAR (HH dB gamma0, EW mode). Acquired: Aug 13, 2026, 09:36 MDT. Open water appears dark; land and sea ice appear bright; dark gray areas were outside the satellite swath. Source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 via Sentinel Hub.

sea_ice.caption: Sentinel-1 HH+HV sea-ice estimate (EW mode), acquired Aug 13, 2026, 09:36 MDT. Sea classification uses the HH−HV polarization difference to separate rough open water (high HH−HV, teal) from sea ice (low HH−HV, cyan→white). Land areas shown in standard SAR grayscale (−15 to +3 dB). Lee 5×5 speckle filter applied before classification. Classification is most reliable in cold conditions; summer melt reduces the polarimetric contrast between ice and wind-roughened water. Source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 via Sentinel Hub.
